blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: A perception system that must brake for a pedestrian does not need a low average latency. It must deliver an answer before the deadline on every frame, the worst case included. Commodity edge accelerators optimize the mean through dynamic scheduling, OS jitter, thermal throttling, and contention, so their per-frame latency can be measured but not bounded. We build FALCON, a camera-based 3D occupancy front-end on the AMD Kria KR260, an embedded FPGA drawing 4.3 W idle and up to 6.6 W under inference, and make the latency guarantee layered and explicit: programmable-logic (PL) compute is cycle-bounded analytically; inference is a measured envelope over 100k-frame traces; and a watchdog enforces output delivery, publishing the previous output flagged stale when a frame is late. The deadline runs use a fixed-work proxy of six ResNet-50 DPU inferences per frame, not the full occupancy network: across three 100k-frame enforced runs, all 300k proxy frames delivered an output within the 100 ms deadline plus at most 10.2 ms, the worst of the three runs. The full six-camera FlashOcc pipeline composes to about 1.3 s per frame on the board and is not yet a 10 Hz system. The two operations the DPU cannot run, a view-transform gather and a bilinear resize, become fixed-trip-count PL IPs numerically matched to their software references. On the full Occ3D-nuScenes validation set the board reaches mIoU 29.88, 92.8% of an FP32 baseline the DPU cannot run. On a ResNet-50 probe over 100k frames the KR260 tail stays within 1.5 times its median (2.0 times for the six-inference proxy), where Jetson Orin reaches 4.4 times and the worst datacenter GPU run (NVIDIA L4) 23.6 times. The deployment recipe, HLS sources, and raw timing traces are released.

blocks.en:
A self-driving stack that brakes for a pedestrian needs perception before the braking deadline on every frame, not just low average latency. Occupancy prediction, a dense 3D map of free and occupied
space [ 40 , 47 , 38 ] , is becoming that safety-bearing layer for vulnerable road users (VRUs:
pedestrians, cyclists, motorcyclists). Yet occupancy methods, from lift-splat models [ 34 , 17 , 51 ] to sparse and set-prediction models [ 28 , 43 ] , are judged mainly by mIoU and sometimes mean FPS.
Mean throughput is the wrong safety currency: on a late frame, the pedestrian is seen too late.

blocks.en:
A safety case uses worst-case execution time (WCET), a per-frame bound checked against the deadline, and
ISO 26262 [ 20 ] asks for that evidence rather than an average. GPUs cannot provide it: datacenter
GPUs and automotive edge SoCs optimize the mean, while dynamic scheduling, driver and OS jitter, thermal
throttling, and contention move the tail [ 29 ] . On a ResNet-50 probe, Jetson Orin’s worst case keeps
climbing with the observation window and swings from 1.1 × 1.1\times to 4.4 × 4.4\times across power modes
and seeds, unlimited power included ( Fig. 1 ). A GPU
latency can be measured but not bounded. A bound needs both a statically scheduled accelerator whose cycle
count is fixed [ 41 , 36 ] and a model with input-invariant work. This is independent
of accuracy: recent occupancy models differ by about 25 × 25\times in determinism, with an input-dependent sparse
model at 27.5 % 27.5\% coefficient of variation (CV) and a fixed-query sparse model at 1.1 % 1.1\% .

blocks.en: Camera-only 3D occupancy descends from Lift-Splat-Shoot [ 34 ] . BEVDet [ 17 ] and BEVDepth [ 24 ] established the deployment-friendly LSS pipeline; SimpleOccupancy [ 13 ] , OccNet [ 38 ] , TPVFormer [ 18 ] , VoxFormer [ 25 ] , OccFormer [ 54 ] , and COTR [ 30 ] explore compact, dense, plane-based, sparse, and transformer-style occupancy representations. RenderOcc uses 2D rendering supervision [ 33 ] ; BEVFormer [ 26 ] , SurroundOcc [ 47 ] , FB-OCC [ 27 ] , OpenOccupancy [ 45 ] , and GaussianFormer [ 19 ] buy accuracy at higher cost; SparseOcc [ 28 ] and OPUS [ 43 ] cut dense-voxel cost. We deploy FlashOcc [ 51 ] , which keeps features in 2D BEV and recovers height with a channel-to-height plug-in. These works optimize mIoU and sometimes mean FPS, not the per-frame latency determinism that decides deadline feasibility ( Sec. 4 ).
blocks.zh: 仅摄像头的3D占用率从升降-浮标-射击 [34]. BEVDET [17] 和BEV深度 [24] 建立 (b) 简单操作[13]、OccNet[38]、TPVFormer[18]、VoxFormer[25]、OccFormer[54]和COTR[30]探索紧凑、密集、基于飞机、稀疏和变压器式的占用说明。 RenderOcc使用2D渲染监督[33];BEVFORmer [26],周边Occ [47],FB-OCC [27],OpenOccancy [45],高斯Former [19] 以更高的成本购买精度;SparseOcc [28]和OPUS [43] 剪切稠密的voxel成本. 我们部署FlashOcc [51],它将特性保存在2D BEV中,并恢复高位,采用通道对高架插座. 这些作品优化了mIoU,有时也指FPS,而不是决定最后期限可行性的每帧延迟决定(第4节).

blocks.en: Low-bit BEV/occupancy quantization is mostly GPU/TensorRT-targeted: QD-BEV [ 53 ] and PTQAT [ 46 ] use QAT, BEVFormer_tensorrt [ 10 ] uses INT8 PTQ, and all rest on general methods such as AdaRound [ 32 ] , BRECQ [ 23 ] , SmoothQuant [ 50 ] , HAQ [ 44 ] , and clipping-based activation quantization [ 9 ] . The AMD/Xilinx DPU [ 2 ] with vai_q_pytorch [ 3 ] is more constrained: per-tensor power-of-two scales and min-max calibration only. We therefore use fixed activation clipping to stay inside the supported DPU path; prior quantized occupancy work rarely reports worst-case timing.
blocks.zh: 低位BEV/使用量量化大多针对GPU/TensorRT:QD-BEV [53]和PTQAT [46]使用QAT,BEVFormer_tensorrt [10]使用INT8 PTQ,所有使用一般方法如AdaRound [32],BRECQ [23],平滑量 [50],HAQ [44],以及以剪切法启动量 [9]. AMD/Xilinx DPU [2] 带有 vai_q_pytorch [3] 的受限性更强:每升2级的功率和分数校准. 因此,我们使用固定的激活剪贴片来停留在被支持的DPU路径内;先前的量化占用工作很少报告最坏的时机.

blocks.en: On the deployment-operator side, BEVPoolv2 [ 16 ] precomputes ranks and intervals for fast GPU LSS pooling, FastOcc [ 15 ] shares 2D BEV and perspective-view features, and TensorRT ports rely on custom plugins [ 10 ] . Their kernels remain GPU software with scheduler jitter, whereas our PL gather and resize turn fixed camera tables into on-chip memories with static trip counts and reported FPGA WCET.
blocks.zh: 在部署-操作方,BEVPoolv2 [16] 预计算快速GPU LSS集合的排名和间隔,FastOcc [15] 共享2D BEV和透视功能,TensorRT端口依赖自定义插件 [10]. 他们的内核仍然是GPU软件,带有调度器焦急,而我们的PL收集并调整大小,将固定的相机表转换成有静态绊倒计数的芯片记忆,并报告了FPGA WCET.

blocks.en: For embedded-FPGA perception, the argument is timing: GPU per-frame latency is hard to bound [ 29 ] , while ISO 26262 [ 20 ] values worst-case evidence over average throughput. Restuccia and Biondi [ 36 ] analyze the Zynq UltraScale+ DPU, and FINN/FINN-R [ 41 , 6 ] with PointPillars-on-FINN [ 39 ] is the closest embedded 3D precedent. Yet PointPillars-on-FINN is LiDAR-based and leaves scatter on ARM, while DPU WCET work treats the accelerator as a generic CNN. No prior work gives a camera-to-occupancy datapath both cycle-bounded view operators and an enforced delivery layer on programmable logic, including the two operations the DPU cannot run.
blocks.zh: 对于嵌入式-FPGA感知,其论据是时间: GPU每帧延迟难于绑定 [29],而ISO 26262 [20] 值值最坏情况的证据大于平均吞吐量. Restuccia和Biondi [36] 分析Zynq Ultra Scale+DPU,FINN/FINN-R [41,6] 与PointPillars-on-FINN [39] 是最接近嵌入式3D先例. 然而PointPillers-on-FINN基于LiDAR,叶片散落在ARM上,而DPU WCET的工作则将加速器视为通用CNN. 之前的工作没有给出一个相机到使用的数据路径,无论是循环限制的视图操作器还是可编程逻辑上强制的传输层,包括DPU无法运行的两种操作.

blocks.en: 3.1 From latency determinability to a hardware split
blocks.zh: 3.1 从延迟确定性到硬件分割

blocks.en: The method follows from three requirements: the model must have input-invariant work; any operation the accelerator cannot run must become a fixed-trip-count hardware operator, not move to a jittery CPU path; and the INT8 deployment must preserve the quantized algorithm with a DPU-compatible calibration recipe [ 21 ] rather than training-heavy QAT [ 12 ] .
blocks.zh: 该方法来自三个要求: 模型必须具有输入-不变量的工作; 任何不能运行的操作必须成为固定的计算硬件操作器,而不是移动到焦急的CPU路径; INT8部署必须用一个DPU兼容的校准配方保存定量算法 [21] 而不是训练-重QAT [12].

The timing path is governed in three layers: PL compute is cycle-bounded; inference latency is a measured envelope; delivery is enforced by a watchdog that publishes the previous ego-warped occupancy, flagged stale, when a frame would miss the deadline. The fallback is conservative only in that known occupied space is retained under ego motion; a VRU first appearing during the missed frame is invisible to it, which is why the output carries the stale flag and why the fallback’s cost is measured directly ( Sec. 4.4 ). The host uses core dedication rather than RT priority, the stable policy for the polling DPU runner ( Sec. 4.1 ). blocks.en: We report host-visible per-frame latency using one-frame submit-and-wait execution. The sweep covers a dedicated KR260 DPU, a dedicated RTX PRO 6000, a shared A100, a Jetson Orin NX (TensorRT 10.3 INT8, 10 to 15 W), and three occupancy models on the shared A100: FlashOcc, SparseOcc, and OPUS. Per-frame statistics exclude a single warmup frame.
blocks.zh: 我们用一个框架的提交和等待执行报告每个框架的可见主机延迟性。 扫码覆盖专用KR260 DPU,专用RTX PRO 6000,共享A100,杰森奥林NX(TensorRT 10.3 INT8,10至15 W),共享A100上的3个占用模式:FlashOcc,SparseOcc,和OPUS. 每个框架的统计数据不包括一个单一的热身框架。

blocks.en: Throughout, host-visible latency is wall time from job submission to completion on the host, the quantity a deadline check sees; a CPU burner is a spin loop pinned to a named core; a co-tenant is an unrelated GPU workload sharing the accelerator (steady: fixed-size matmul loop; bursty: randomized sizes and sleeps); seeds are repeated runs launched at different times with freshly initialized processes, nothing else varying. The 100 100 k-frame runs replay a fixed input tensor, so work is input-invariant by construction and residual variation is platform-induced; Fig. 4 e varies content explicitly. Conservative occupancy names the fallback of Eq. 7 : the previous output ego-warped, flagged stale, unable to contain objects first visible in the missed frame. Latency probes use ResNet-50@224 INT8 on the DPU; accuracy runs use the deployed FlashOcc xmodels (trunk 256 × 704 256{\times}704 , BEV stage bev_clamp32 ); BEV-stage latency traces use the structurally identical bev_reluc compile. Software: XRT 2.13.0, Vitis AI 2.5/3.0, PYNQ-DPU, Ubuntu 22.04. All runs use batch 1 1 , one frame in flight: DPU INT8 on the stock B4096 overlay, custom IPs at 200 200 MHz, GPU probes FP16 at stock clocks, Orin TensorRT 10.3 10.3 INT8 at the stated power mode. Latency curves time the current frame’s inference only; fallback delivery is measured separately ( Fig. 5(b) ).

blocks.en: The relevant target is the INT8 algorithm, because the DPU cannot run FP32. Quantizing only the BEV stage (clamp 32, trunk FP32) reaches 98 % 98\% of FP32 mIoU (32.19 to 31.6 on 6019 frames), isolating the clip cost. Reference configurations matter: an idealized clamp-16 reference gives 29.08; the reference matched to the deployed configuration (clamp 32, view transform quantized as deployed, INT16 at 1 / 128 1/128 resolution) scores 31.43, and the board reaches 29.88 against it, a 1.55 gap attributable to the real per-layer quantizer realization. Quantizing the view transform to INT8 instead would cost 9.4 mIoU (22.01 vs 31.43), the direct justification for the INT16 gather datapath. The feature cosine 0.873: board trunk output and the quantizer’s CPU simulation score identically against FP32 features (0.87323 both), so the deploy chain adds nothing on top of quantization itself; the number measures PTQ cost, not deployment error, whose task-level effect Tab. 3 reports.

blocks.en: We evaluate deadlines in two frames. The relative frame sets each hard deadline as a fixed margin over the platform median, testing whether a platform reliably meets a deadline sized to its own throughput: at a 10 % 10\% margin over 100 100 k frames the dedicated KR260 probe (one ResNet-50@224 inference per frame) misses 0.011 % 0.011\% , against 4.5% for the loaded GPU and 0.5% for the thermally-throttled Orin at their own margins ( Fig. 5(c) ); shorter traces can show zero misses at this margin, so measured maxima are reported as envelopes, not bounds. The absolute frame scores the deployment against a fixed 100 100 ms perception budget: at urban 50 50 km/h the vehicle travels 1.4 1.4 m per budget interval. On this budget, the six-inference DPU frame-budget probe (six sequential ResNet-50@224 INT8 inferences per frame, 6 × 6\times the relative-frame probe’s accelerator work, held fixed; exact configuration in the released code and traces) runs at 95.5 95.5 ms median and misses on 0.027 0.027 to 0.152 % 0.152\% of unenforced frames across three 100 100 k-frame seeds ( 0.070 % 0.070\% pooled), with per-seed maxima of 124.3 124.3 , 133.2 133.2 , and 169.0 169.0 ms; the enforced run of Fig. 5(b) is a separate trace, on which the watchdog converts every miss into a flagged fallback, every output landing within 7.8 7.8 ms of the deadline over 100 100 k enforced frames ( 10.2 10.2 ms worst over all three enforced runs). The full-resolution FlashOcc pipeline is far heavier than this proxy ( Tab. 2 ): accelerated stages compose to roughly 0.8 0.8 s per frame serial, and the CPU head, a pointwise two-layer MLP over the 200 × 200 200{\times}200 grid ( 22 22 GFLOP), measures 6.7 6.7 s as an unoptimized FP32 NumPy reference on the A53 cores; recompiled as two 1 × 1 1{\times}1 -convolution DPU subgraphs with an int8 lookup-table softplus bridge it runs at 505 505 ms median (stage medians 89.6 89.6 , 389.3 389.3 , 31.7 31.7 ms; independent medians need not sum to the end-to-end median; 97.3 % 97.3\% argmax agreement with the FP32 head), 13 × 13\times faster than that unoptimized reference. The full pipeline thus composes to about 1.3 1.3 s per frame. Input downscaling does not buy this back: the BEV stage is independent of image resolution, and halving the trunk input without retraining collapses accuracy ( 4.32 4.32 vs 20.48 20.48 mIoU paired, under a superseded view-transform scale, so the ratio is the evidence), and halving the BEV grid needs an architecture-consistent neck. A 10 10 Hz tier therefore requires a retrained reduced-grid model, a measured engineering boundary rather than a knob.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion, Limitations, and Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论、限制和结论

blocks.en: This work is a deployment result, not a new occupancy backbone: a camera occupancy network becomes easier to certify when algorithm, accelerator mapping, and runtime policy all expose fixed work. The latency guarantee is layered, and only one layer is a bound: PL compute is cycle-bounded analytically; inference latency is a measured envelope whose maxima are sample-size-dependent; delivery is structurally guaranteed, possibly with a stale-flagged fallback. Raw miss rates span tenfold across enforced runs and raw maxima wander 125.2 125.2 to 139.8 139.8 ms, yet every frame delivered within the deadline plus the envelope of Sec. 4.3 . That envelope is itself measured: the enforcement timer is a host thread, and the PL-side timer that would remove its wake tail is not implemented. A back-to-back run after prior host activity misses more often than clean boot ( 0.671 0.671 vs 0.070 % 0.070\% ), drift that runtime monitoring must catch. The timing-closed K26 bitstream co-places the DPU and both resize IP instances; the gather IP runs from its own overlay, so the full pipeline has not run as one bitstream. The evidence is dataset replay on hardware, not a moving-vehicle test: on-car synchronization, planner-interface timing, actuation, and real-traffic fallback remain future validation, with runtime fault monitoring [ 5 , 37 , 42 ] .
blocks.zh: 这项工作是一个部署结果,而不是一个新的占用主干线:当算法、加速器绘图和运行时间政策都暴露固定工作时,一个摄像头占用网络就更容易认证。 延迟保证是分层的,只有一层是绑定的:PL计算是循环的,分析上;推论延迟是一个测量到的信封,其最大值是样本大小依赖;交付是结构上的保证,可能有一个标定的倒置. 原始误差率跨执行跑道达10倍,原始最大误差125.2 125.2至139.8 139.8 ms,然而在最后期限内交付的每一帧都加上第4.3节的信封。 这个信封本身是测量的:执行定时器是主机线程,而去除其醒尾的PL侧定时器没有执行. 先前主机活动之后的背向运行比干净的靴子(0.671 0.671 vs 0.070% 0.070 \%)更频繁的错过,运行时间监测的漂移必须赶上. 计时关闭的K26比特流将DPU和两个调整IP大小的例放在一起;集合IP从自己的覆盘中运行,因此整个管道没有作为一个比特流运行. 其证据是在硬件上重放数据集,而不是移动车辆测试:在车上同步,规划者交互计时,激活,以及真实流量回落仍然是未来的验证,运行时断层监测[5,37,42].

blocks.en: On-board VRU recall (pedestrian 14.8 % 14.8\% , bicycle 5.7 % 5.7\% ) and night mIoU ( 16.76 16.76 ) are far below what a braking function needs, and the fallback lowers recall further on late frames ( Sec. 4.4 ); we claim no recall level as sufficient, since it comes from the system safety case [ 42 ] . The timing layer is model-independent, so a more accurate fixed-work model inherits it unchanged. The platform comparison is not matched in precision or isolation: GPUs run FP16, datacenter runs share cluster nodes, and the KR260 is dedicated. A real-time-configured GPU, Orin’s DLA, or another FPGA would be fairer baselines.
blocks.zh: 机上VRU召回(pederestrian 14.8% \%,自行车 5.7% 5.7\%)和夜间mIoU(16.76 16.76)远远低于制动功能的需要,而后退的召回进一步降低在后退的帧(sec 4.4);我们声称召回级别不够,因为它来自系统安全案例[42]. 计时层是模型独立的,因此一个更准确的固定工作模型继承它不会改变. 平台比较没有精确或孤立的匹配: GPU运行FP16,数据中心运行共享集群节点,KR260是专用的. 实时配置的GPU、Orin的DLA或另一个FPGA将是更公平的基线。

blocks.en: Determinism does not remove compute cost ( Sec. 4.3 ), but the condition is not FlashOcc-specific: fixed rigs and tensor shapes turn LSS splatting and known-shape resampling into static-index gathers with certifiable trip counts, extending FPGA determinism evidence [ 22 , 35 ] to camera occupancy. The HLS sources, deployment recipe, and raw 100 100 k-frame traces are released at github.com/Que121/falcon-kr260-release .
